instruction: Mark all emails in the Sent folder as read

rules.sql: select (select count(*) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 59 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 10)) = (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 10);

metadata.explanation: Task requires marking all emails in Sent folder (folderID=10, contains 2 emails) as read. The evaluator checks if read attribute (attributeID=59, value=1) is set for messages in folder 10. Verified from database: folder 10 is Sent with 2 emails.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies that ALL emails in the Sent folder are marked as read
SQL query compares count of read emails with count of total emails using equality check: (count of read emails in folder 10) = (count of all emails in folder 10)
Complete coverage: checks all emails in folderID=10 (Sent folder) as specified in the instruction
Correct database schema usage: folderID=10 for Sent folder, attributeID=59 with value=1 for read status
Appropriate postconfig: closes Thunderbird before reading database to prevent lock issues
Return value semantics correct: returns 1.0 only when counts match (all emails read), 0.0 otherwise
